mapper.sql: id , upload_id, bucket_name, object_name, original_filename, content_type, md5, file_size, chunk_size, chunk_count, access_type, creator_id, status, media_file_id, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.insert: insert into media_upload_task (upload_id, bucket_name, object_name, original_filename, content_type, md5, file_size, chunk_size, chunk_count, access_type, creator_id, status) values (#{uploadId}, #{bucketName}, #{objectName}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{md5}, #{fileSize}, #{chunkSize}, #{chunkCount}, #{accessType}, #{creatorId}, #{status})
mapper.select:
select
from media_upload_task where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0 limit 1
